annotations.title: Send a message to another agent

description: Deliver a text message from you ("heldfast-churn-placeholder") to another coding agent's inbox, for example to hand off a task, ask a question or report a result. Call mail_peers first if you are unsure of the recipient name. To answer a message you received from mail_check, pass its id as reply_to. Each call writes one new message and never edits or removes existing mail. If the recipient has not started yet, the message waits in its inbox. Returns "sent <id> to <name>"; keep the id if you expect a reply that references it.

body.description: Message text, in plain text or Markdown. Include everything the recipient needs, since it cannot see your conversation.

reply_to.description: Optional. The id of the message you are answering (the value in [brackets] from mail_check), so the recipient can match the reply to its question.

to.description: Recipient agent name as listed by mail_peers, e.g. "codex", "claude" or "gemini". Letters, digits, _ and -, with optional .suffix segments.

name: mail_send
title: Send a message to another agent
